messages:
maria_cs: FYI Pulsar onboarding is hitting strange auth + rate behaviour after we gave them the SDK. Seeing periodic 401 then a wave of 429s within seconds. Anyone free to triage? :eyes:
rebecca_dev: I can take a look. Do we have an example request/headers from their SDK?
josh_infra: Also curious if it's preflight fanout — are they doing parallel preflight calls or ephemeral token refresh loops?
maria_cs: Got a few logs from their proxy: first a 401 then a burst of preflight 429s. Pasted snippet from their edge logs:
POST /v1/generate 401
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJ... (shortlived)
User-Agent: PulsarSDK/0.4.2

Then client does 20 parallel retries and we see 429s from preflight endpoint.
rebecca_dev: That token looks shortlived — maybe clock skew or token issued for wrong scope. If the client sees 401 and immediately retries in parallel with new tokens that can cause a thundering-fanout. Can we confirm token TTL?
maria_cs: Customer says tokens are ~30s TTL from their auth service.
alex_eng: 30s is tight. If their web clients all refresh at the same time, we get refresh storms. Recommend jitter + distributed refresh window. Also we have the preflight endpoint that does key validation — can we add a short memo cache on our edge for last-successful-subject to reduce token introspect QPS?
josh_infra: We can add a tiny in-memory cache on sdkgateway for validated actor id with 5s TTL to swallow immediate retried requests. Low risk.
rebecca_dev: Quick mitigation steps: 1) ask customer to add randomized jitter (100-500ms) to token refresh and retry; 2) set exponential backoff on 401s (not immediate parallel).
tom_support: I posted suggested patch to their SDK sample in the support ticket, including this snippet:
// JS example: avoid refresh storms
async function getToken() {
  if (tokenExpiresSoon()) {
    await sleep(Math.floor(Math.random() * 400)); // jitter
    return await fetchToken();
  }
  return token;
}
maria_cs: Customer OK to patch but asks if we can do an immediate server-side tweak while they roll out changes.
alex_eng: We can deploy a small gate on sdkgateway to treat a burst of identical subject preflight failures as a single validation attempt for 3s. Will reduce backend load. Need a quick PR and infra deploy.
rebecca_dev: I'll open the PR and add a feature flag so we can toggle per-customer.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: sdkgateway/cache-gate feature-flag branch -> staging (sha: c4b2f3a)
josh_infra: Monitoring: add a dashboard for preflight QPS and 401->429 correlation for Pulsar org id. Also set an alert if preflight QPS spike > 200/s sustained 30s.
maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll message the customer with step-by-step: apply jitter + backoff and expect reduced errors once we flip the flag. Schedule a quick sync at 15:30 PT to monitor. :thumbsup:
rebecca_dev: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdkgateway/pull/718 — ready for review.
alex_eng: After staging verification we can roll to production to the Pulsar tenant only.
tom_support: I'll add notes to the onboarding checklist about recommending token TTL >= 2 minutes or client-side jitter/backoff.
maria_cs: Closing loop: sync in 40m, will update thread with customer rollout progress.
